interface.title: Ouvia Study Portal (admin dashboard and participant annotation portal)
interface.field: Speech translation evaluation / human-centred NLP usability studies (crowdsourced, Prolific-style)
interface.stage_of_work: Study setup, data collection management and monitoring, and data export
interface.what_it_is_for: Lets a study coordinator load source conversations with reference Q&A, set up sender/receiver/validator accounts, assign each sender→translation→receiver→validator chain, watch progress, and export snapshots, while participants record, answer and validate in role-specific screens.

data.note: Uploaded conversations.csv (5 conversations, 8 questions), users.csv (2 senders, 2 receivers, 1 validator) and conversation_entries.csv (5 entries: sender01→C001–C003, sender02→C004–C005). Added validator02 by hand. Receivers and validators were assigned with the entries table's bulk actions, not CSV. The UI previews use built-in mock data (DEMO-001 hotel booking).

features.name: CSV bulk import with import summary
features.general: Pick a spreadsheet with required columns, upload it, and read back counts of added, updated, skipped and invalid rows
features.specific: Dashboard upload cards (Conversation CSV, User CSV, Sender<>Conversation entries, Receiver/Validator assignments) that list required columns and show an Import Summary grid after upload
steps: read the required-columns hint
Choose File and pick the CSV
press Upload
read the summary tiles (added/updated/skipped/invalid) and the updated totals
serves_tasks: Import source prompts with reference questions and answers from a spreadsheet
Bulk-create participant accounts from a spreadsheet
Pair each speaker with the source items they will voice, from a spreadsheet

features.name: Selectable table with bulk role assignment
features.general: Tick rows (or select all) in a data table, open a bulk-actions menu, choose which role field to set or clear, enter a user ID, and apply to every selected row
features.specific: Conversation Entries table: row checkboxes and Select all → 'N selected' bar → Bulk actions (Delete selected; Set / clear Sender / Receiver / Validator / Final Sender) → modal 'User unique ID (Prolific ID)', empty to clear → Apply, confirmed by an alert and a refreshed table. No check that the ID belongs to a user of the matching role.
steps: tick rows or Select all rows
open Bulk actions
choose Set / clear <role>
type a unique ID (or leave empty to clear)
press Apply and check the column in the refreshed table
serves_tasks: Assign listeners who answer comprehension questions to selected items in bulk
Assign a reviewer to all items at once

features.name: Pipeline-state dashboard with bar chart
features.general: Count items in each stage of a multi-step workflow, shown as tiles and a hoverable bar chart, with a breakdown by a participant attribute
features.specific: Admin statistics: Total conversation entries, Assigned conversations by sender gender (table and grouped bars), Conversation entry states (ready/recorded/translated/evaluated/validated/completed) tiles and bar chart, and states by sender gender
steps: open Stats
read the totals and gender table
scroll to the entry-state tiles and chart
hover a bar for its count
serves_tasks: View pipeline-stage counts and demographic balance

features.name: Per-item provenance detail view
features.general: Open one work item to see who did each step, the raw input, the machine output, and each evaluator's answers against the reference
features.specific: Entry Detail: status badges, Assigned participants (Sender/Receiver/Validator/Final Sender cards linking to user entries), Sender final survey, Sender recording, Source vs Translated text with corrections count, Receiver questions & responses table with reference answer and validator verdict
steps: click an Entry ID in the entries table
check the assigned participants
compare source text with translation
read the receiver responses against the reference answers and validator verdicts
serves_tasks: Inspect one item's full chain of contributions

features.name: Translation validation form (answer correctness and quality slider)
features.general: Show a reviewer the source, the machine translation and others' answers; have them flag a source/audio mismatch, mark each answer correct or not, and rate overall quality on a labelled 0–6 slider
features.specific: Validator Annotation: Audio-text mismatch checkbox, Comprehension Questions table with Yes/No toggles per Portuguese answer, English source and Machine translation (Portuguese), 'Translation quality score' slider with anchors 0 Nonsense / 2 Some Meaning / 4 Most Meaning / 6 Perfect, Save validation, View validator instructions modal
steps: read the source and machine translation
optionally tick audio-text mismatch
toggle Yes/No for each answer
drag the quality slider (score readout updates, e.g. 5.0→2.0)
press Save validation
serves_tasks: Preview what each role will see before launching

features.name: Read-aloud recorder with progress
features.general: Show a passage to read, record it with the browser microphone, stop, re-record or save, with a progress bar over the participant's queue
features.specific: Sender Recording: Passage to read, ● Record / Stop / Re-record / Save recording, PROGRESS 'n of N tasks completed', Back to assignments
steps: read the passage
press ● Record
press Stop
optionally Re-record
press Save recording and move to the next assignment
serves_tasks: Open a speaker's assigned recording task as that participant
Preview what each role will see before launching

features.name: Role signup links with consent gate

features.specific: Dashboard 'Role signup links' with Copy buttons → /signup?role=…&authkey=… page with ID do Prolific, English/Português consent toggle, accept checkbox, Criar conta; refuses when not enough entries are available

features.name: Snapshot and CSV export

features.name: Post-task agreement-scale survey
features.general: After finishing their items, a participant rates a set of statements (e.g. satisfaction) on a labelled agreement scale and submits
features.specific: Sender Final Survey (seen only as a UI preview with mock data): Likert statements such as Satisfaction with options up to 'Agree'/'Strongly agree'; submission disabled in preview
steps: open the survey after the final task
read each statement
pick a point on the agreement scale for each
submit the survey
